displayTitle: The Mandalorian - The Art & Imagery Collector's Edition, Volume One
synopsis: A deluxe collector's edition focusing on the the first live-action Star Wars TV series, now streaming on Disney+Celebrate the all-new hit Star Wars TV Show The Mandalorian in this special edition that brings fans up close and personal to the cast, crew and making of the highly anticipated new chapter in the Star Wars saga. Features award - winning artists from the series such as DOUG CHIANG, CHRISTIAN ALZMANN, RYAN CHURCH and more!
title: Star Wars: The Mandalorian - The Art & Imagery Collector's Edition, Volume One
